name: Roper Technologies
description: Roper is a holding company that buys and runs niche vertical-software businesses and a smaller group of technology-enabled products. In 2022 it sold a majority stake in its old industrial businesses (Indicor, to CD&R) and now gets about 78% of revenue from software: cloud and license products for law firms, government contractors, schools, childcare centers, insurance agencies, labs and others, and online marketplaces such as DAT (freight) and iTradeNetwork (food). The rest is hardware such as Neptune water meters, Verathon airway devices and CIVCO ultrasound accessories. Software revenue is mostly recurring subscriptions and support (57% of total revenue), with transaction fees and one-time licenses making up the rest. Roper grows by acquiring (about $8.96B spent in three years, including CentralReach $1.85B and Subsplash $0.8B in 2025) and by buying back stock ($2.7B in H1 2026).

gics.note: Conventional GICS label recorded from general knowledge of the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source in this pass. Roper was historically an industrial conglomerate; whether GICS currently places it in Industrials or Information Technology was not checked. SEC SIC code is 3823 (Industrial Instruments for Measurement, Display, and Control), a leftover of its past.
